start: Owner online, Settings → Gym timings, no timings saved yet

steps.action: Pick one of 'Start from', change a day under 'Every week', add a special day ('Special day 1: date', 'why (optional)'), type the 'Note for members (optional)'
user_sees: Title 'Gym timings', subtitle 'When your gym is open, for members to see'
A preview of what members will see
must_not: Nothing saved before Save is tapped
A day that closes before it opens accepted without a word

user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…' then 'Saved ✓'
Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
'These timings are saved (<day>) and members see them. Change any time above to save again.'
'Last saved <day> by <name>.'
must_not: Two saves from a double tap
Another branch’s timings changed
Saved ✓ shown when the save failed

start: Owner online, Settings → Member app → Busy machines (shown once the server has it)

steps.action: Tick 'Show busy machines to members', type how many of each machine under 'How many of each do you have?', add one under 'Machines you added' ('Machine name', 'How many?', 'Which exercises are done on it?')
user_sees: Title 'Busy machines', subtitle 'Tell members when a machine is usually busy'
'<n> machines on your list can get busy (you have 1 or 2).'
must_not: A machine with 3 or more counted as one that can get busy
More than 30 own machines added

user_sees: Toast 'Saved.'
'Last saved <day> by <name>.'
'No changes to save.' after it
must_not: Members shown who used a machine
Busy times shown to members while the tick is off

start: Owner on Settings today (the MettleUp Plus switch for members is off for everyone)

steps.action: Scroll the Gym tab of Settings
user_sees: No 'Free MettleUp Plus for your members' card
must_not: A lock switch shown that does nothing
Members’ features locked after a plan ends while the card is hidden
Members’ workouts or history ever locked

start: Owner opens Gym timings or Busy machines when the gym is not online, or the server part is missing, or the read fails

user_sees: 'Gym timings need your gym online' / 'Busy machines need your gym online' with 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
or 'Gym timings are not switched on for your gym yet' / 'Busy machines are not ready for your gym yet'
or an error line with 'Try again'
must_not: An editor that cannot save
An endless Loading…

steps.action: With timings open, type a wrong time and tap save
user_sees: 'Fix the times below to see what members will see.' and a problem line
must_not: Wrong times saved
The typed values wiped

user_sees: Button goes from 'Saved ✓' to 'Save timings'
must_not: Save stays off after a change

steps.action: Tap the remove button; in 'Remove the gym timings?' confirm
user_sees: 'Members will no longer see when your gym is open. You can add the timings again at any time.'
Toast 'Gym timings removed. Members no longer see them.'
'Start from' is offered again
must_not: Members still shown the old timings for longer than the app’s refresh
The remove done without the question

steps.action: Busy machines: untick 'Show busy machines to members' and save
user_sees: Toast 'Saved.'
must_not: Members still shown busy times
The machine counts lost when switched off

steps.action: Read the line under the tick and save
user_sees: Words that say members see when a machine is usually busy
must_not: A member’s name or visit time shown to other members
Machine use collected from members while the switch is off

start: Staff online, Settings → Gym timings; the owner saved timings

user_sees: 'Your gym’s timings' with 'Every week' and 'Special days'
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: Any box staff can type in
A save or remove button

user_sees: The machine list as read-only
'Only the owner can change this.'
must_not: The tick or the counts open to change

start: Staff online; the owner never saved timings or machines

steps.action: Open Gym timings, then Busy machines
user_sees: 'No timings yet.'
'No machines yet.'
must_not: A 'Start from' list for staff
An error in place of the empty words

start: Staff has Gym timings open; the owner changes them on another device

user_sees: The new timings
must_not: The old timings kept until sign-out
